# leopard.in.ua

> > Personal site of Alexey Vasiliev (leopard): Software Architect specializing in PostgreSQL, Ruby on Rails, and DevOps tooling

This site features practical developer tools including PGTune (PostgreSQL configuration generator) and SQL Joins Visualizer, alongside technical articles about database optimization, Chef infrastructure automation, and full-stack development. Alexey Vasiliev shares expertise in PostgreSQL performance tuning, Ruby/Rails development, and infrastructure as code.

## Key Topics

- PostgreSQL
- Database Optimization
- PgTune
- Ruby on Rails
- Chef Infrastructure
- DevOps
- SQL Joins
- Web Development
- Chef Server
- B-Tree Indexes
- Infrastructure Automation
- Full-Stack Engineering
- Configuration Management

## Developer Tools

- [PGTune - PostgreSQL Configuration Calculator](https://pgtune.leopard.in.ua): PGTune: PostgreSQL performance tuning config generator by hardware specs
- [SQL Joins Visualizer](https://sql-joins.leopard.in.ua): SQL Joins Visualizer: Build JOIN queries using Venn diagrams
- [VMail FAQ](https://vmail.leopard.in.ua/faq): VMail FAQ: HTML email template validation and compatibility testing

## PostgreSQL & Database Articles

- [PostgreSQL Indexes](https://leopard.in.ua/2015/04/13/postgresql-indexes): Deep dive into PostgreSQL indexes: B-Tree, R-Tree, and query optimization

## Infrastructure & DevOps

- [Cooking Infrastructure by Chef](https://chef.leopard.in.ua): Complete Chef guide: infrastructure automation, Chef Solo & Chef Server
